name: Captions model
why: About 140 MB, one-time download. Times the on-screen words to the voice. Runs on this computer. Videos never download it themselves.

install: d="$(mktemp -d)" && ffmpeg -loglevel error -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=16000:cl=mono -t 2 "$d/silence.wav" && (cd "$d" && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes transcribe silence.wav --model base.en --language en >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -rf "$d"; true)

$d = Join-Path $env:TEMP ([guid]::NewGuid()); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d | Out-Null; ffmpeg -loglevel error -f lavfi -i anullsrc=r=16000:cl=mono -t 2 "$d/silence.wav"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $d; exit 1 }; Push-Location $d; $env:HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY = '1'; hyperframes transcribe silence.wav --model base.en --language en *> $null; Pop-Location; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $d; exit 0
